consequence.statement: Static listeners now bypass the overload manager by default; it still works, but differently.
consequence.remediation: Set BYPASS_OVERLOAD_MANAGER_FOR_STATIC_LISTENERS to false in the agent Deployment to revert.

assertion.statement: Istio now bypasses the overload manager for static listeners; setting env var BYPASS_OVERLOAD_MANAGER_FOR_STATIC_LISTENERS to false in the agent Deployment reverts this.
